q: Sofic groups are defined as groups that can be approximated by:
opts: Finite symmetric groups (permutation groups) in a metric sense
exp: A group G is sofic if it can be approximated by finite symmetric groups: for any finite F ⊆ G and ε > 0, there is a map to Sym(n) that is an almost-homomorphism on F with almost-free action. All amenable and all residually finite groups are sofic.
